panels.title: Runs: selected thresholds on val (tau sweep)
panels.description: selection rule: best val quality with cost <= random baseline

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT r.name AS run, (SELECT value FROM tags t WHERE t.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND t.key = 'pool') AS pool, (SELECT value FROM tags t WHERE t.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND t.key = 'config') AS config, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'epochs_run' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS epochs, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'best_val_loss' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS best_val_loss, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'tau.tau' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS tau, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'tau.halt_tau' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS halt_tau, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'tau.val_quality' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS val_quality, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'tau.val_cost_usd' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS val_cost_usd, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'tau.random_quality' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS random_quality, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'tau.oracle.oracle_quality' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS oracle_quality, r.status AS status FROM runs r WHERE r.name IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND r.lifecycle_stage = 'active' ORDER BY r.name
targets.queryText: SELECT r.name AS run, (SELECT value FROM tags t WHERE t.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND t.key = 'pool') AS pool, (SELECT value FROM tags t WHERE t.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND t.key = 'config') AS config, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'epochs_run' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS epochs, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'best_val_loss' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS best_val_loss, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'tau.tau' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS tau, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'tau.halt_tau' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS halt_tau, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'tau.val_quality' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS val_quality, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'tau.val_cost_usd' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS val_cost_usd, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'tau.random_quality' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS random_quality, (SELECT value FROM metrics x WHERE x.run_uuid = r.run_uuid AND x.key = 'tau.oracle.oracle_quality' ORDER BY x.step DESC, x.timestamp DESC LIMIT 1) AS oracle_quality, r.status AS status FROM runs r WHERE r.name IN (${run:sqlstring}) AND r.lifecycle_stage = 'active' ORDER BY r.name
